A '''panoramic optical sensor''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. [[Metrocab Robo-Hack Landspeeder]]s had a panoramic optical sensor mounted at the rear which acted as the vehicle's rear-view [[Mirror/Legends|mirror]].<ref name="EGTD" />
